names.zh: 象岛城镇与神庙发掘组合（Kaiser MDAIK 26）

summary.zh: Kaiser 等 MDAIK 26（1970）首报公布的城镇/神庙区出土建筑与器物语境；后续季报另册，本组合仅锚定首报。
summary.en: Town/temple architectural and object contexts as first published in Kaiser et al. MDAIK 26 (1970); later seasons are separate — this assemblage anchors the inaugural report only.
